object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: In a document whose manifest makes the enumeration attribute status required, remove status from an object's file and validate. Separately, in a document that validates clean, define a new required integer attribute weight, which no object sets, and validate. Expected: ATTR_MISSING_REQUIRED both times, and no ATTR_BAD_INTEGER the second time.
